title: Every Man Should Train A Martial Art
hook: I strongly believe that every man should train in some kind of martial art.
body: Every man should be able to protect himself and his family, and most men today can't. I dedicated about 20 years to training, invested in private lessons, and earned my black belt, and it made me a better person in so many ways. It made me better at dealing with conflict, and I get far less frustrated when things get complicated. I personally love Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, but you can do Muay Thai, Judo, or another martial art that appeals to you more.
close: Leave a comment to let me know which martial art you train, or which one you want to start.
